get.description: Returns a collection of all visible tags for the given status, if user is authorized

404.description: No status found for this id

post.description:
Creates a single StatusTag Object, if user is authorized to. Triggers a `checkin_update` webhook event.

The key of a tag is free text. You can choose it as you need it. However, please use a namespace for tags (namespace:xxx) that only affect your own application.

For tags related to standard actions we recommend the following tags in the trwl namespace:
  • trwl:seat (i.e. 61)
  • trwl:wagon (i.e. 25)
  • trwl:ticket (i.e. BahnCard 100 first))
  • trwl:price (420,69 €)
  • trwl:travel_class (i.e. 1, 2, business, economy, ...)
  • trwl:locomotive_class (BR424, BR450)
  • trwl:journey_number (i.e. 1234. Used as a work-around for missing journey numbers)
  • trwl:wagon_class (i.e. Bpmz)
  • trwl:role (i.e. Tf, Zf, Gf, Lokführer, conducteur de train, ...)
  • trwl:vehicle_number (i.e. 425 001, Tz9001, 123, ...)
  • trwl:passenger_rights (i.e. yes / no / ID of claim)
  • trwl:social_status – social availability indicator. Allowed values: open (open to chatting), open_find_me (open, but staying at seat), open_lets_hang (open and willing to move around), do_not_disturb (prefer not to be disturbed).

404.description: No status found for this id

403.description: User not authorized to manipulate this status
